name: Yamae Group Holdings Co.,Ltd.
summary: Yamae Group Holdings Co.,Ltd. engages in the wholesale of food products in Japan. The company offers general processed foods, frozen food, confectionery, alcoholic beverages, livestock, bento boxes, shochu, marine products, feed, housing equipment, and construction materials. It is also involved in the leasing of real estate and other related businesses, such as transportation, fuel-related business, rental car business, information processing service business, and solar power generation business. The company serves the food manufacturing industry and restaurants. Yamae Group Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1950 and is headquartered in Fukuoka, Japan.
